window.basis: Formal venue/acceptance chronology, not initial preprint date; within-venue ordering does not imply exact publication order.

eligibility: First/co-first, last, or explicitly verified corresponding authors were eligible. These selected papers all meet the last-listed-author criterion. Pixel Mean Flows, Fractal Generative Models, Noise Conditioning, and PISA additionally have explicit correspondence designations on the read PDF first page. This is a bounded corpus snapshot, not proof of exhaustive worldwide coverage.
coverage_note: Source-derived writing observations include main-text, section-level, substantive-appendix, and sentence-level readings. The observation index records page/section locators. Visual inspection is selective; it does not establish that every figure or supplementary artifact was inspected.
limitations: Author position does not identify who wrote particular sentences.
TMLR is a peer-reviewed ML journal and is not relabeled TPAMI/IJCV.
NeurIPS 2026 entries are accepted/forthcoming as of the snapshot date.
DHN and Fractal use public author versions; inaccessible final journal PDFs are not claimed to have been read.
The ICLR 2025 boundary entries qualify by formal venue date even when first preprints predate the window.
Source PDFs and original paper passages are not included in this skill.
A separately mentioned Natural Image Pretraining supplement was not obtained; available main PDF content was studied.
